from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from aspenops_nexus.cache import ResultCache, _encode_payloads

payloads = {
    "one": {"z": 2, "a": "聚丙烯", "nested": [1, 2]},
    "two": {"value": 3.5, "flag": True},
}
encoded = _encode_payloads(payloads)
assert encoded["one"] == '{"a":"聚丙烯","nested":[1,2],"z":2}'
with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="aspenops-cache-write-wheel-") as temporary:
    cache = ResultCache(Path(temporary) / "cache.sqlite3")
    cache.put_many(payloads)
    assert cache.get_many(list(payloads)) == payloads
